scope: LLaVA-1.5-7B, EN legacy Dev 20230712, K128; stored V11 answers projected only

rules.strict_model_input: Exact native prompt, equal FP16 CLIP336 padded tensor bytes and original image_sizes; no GT in matching.
rules.same_content_diagnostic: Exact native prompt, same image size, processed RGB8 RMSE<=3 and dHash distance<=2; recompressed pixels can differ. Diagnostic only.
rules.same_ID_prompt_diagnostic: Same row ID and exact native prompt only; image differences are not filtered. Diagnostic only.
rules.circular: Score an old group only when every old rotation has a selected answer; every rotation must match old GT.
rules.letters: Use original stored answer letters without permutation/remapping.

limits: Content-compatible images do not guarantee equal model predictions on the original encoded old images.
Missing groups remain unknown; covered-subset percentages are not full1176-group scores.
Old GT alignment does not establish that older labels are factually more correct.
The stored EADP and historical AnchorZip executions differ in stream-wait repair.
